summary: Humacyte filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its distribution agreement with Fresenius Medical Care. Under the Third Amendment, Humacyte regains sole worldwide rights to develop and commercialize its 6mm acellular tissue engineered vessel, while Fresenius retains a low-single-digit royalty on ex-U.S. net sales (with a two-year royalty-free period post-launch per country). U.S. royalty rates continue in the mid-single to low double digits. This is a contractual reversion of rights, not a merger or acquisition. No price per share, premium, or tender terms are involved. Watch for potential future partnership or commercialization updates.
